UJP PRAHA a.s. historically continues the activities of the former Institute of Nuclear Fuels, gradually incorporating activities from many other fields into its portfolio. Among the most important are our extensive and long-standing experience in processing uranium and other materials for shielding protection, the production of transport and storage containers for sources of ionizing radiation, and a broad portfolio of products and services.
The engineering production at the company is based on the results of its own research and development across many sectors, such as aviation, the energy industry, the chemical industry, petrochemicals, and mechanical engineering. The advanced technology for processing metallic uranium through melting, alloying, machining, surface protection of uranium, uranium parts, and products made from metallic depleted uranium has been and continues to be further developed here. UJP PRAHA a.s., as the only facility in the Czech Republic, offers a wide range of transport and storage containers for radioactive sources utilizing the shielding properties of metallic uranium, lead, and tungsten, as well as shielding parts made of metallic uranium, small uranium products, and uranium compounds for both domestic and international markets.

Van Halteren Technologies Boxtel B.V. is a high-tech engineering and manufacturing company based in Boxtel, the Netherlands. It is part of the broader Van Halteren Technologies group, a Dutch family-owned enterprise known for delivering advanced technological solutions across defense, energy, maritime, simulation, and increasingly, the space industry.
The Boxtel branch specializes in the design, development, and production of fluid power systems, motion control technologies, and precision mechanical components like large hydraulic cylinders and electromechanical actuators. These capabilities are critical for a wide range of applications, including military land systems, training simulators, and environmental control systems.
In recent years, Van Halteren Technologies Boxtel has expanded its portfolio to serve space-related customers, providing high-reliability components and subsystems that meet the stringent demands of the aerospace sector. These include custom hydraulic and electromechanical systems, and precision actuators used in launch infrastructure. The company’s expertise in motion simulation and control also supports testing and validation platforms for eg. space applications.
With a strong foundation in engineering excellence, the Boxtel facility is equipped with modern manufacturing and testing infrastructure, enabling it to deliver turnkey solutions and custom-built systems for both commercial and governmental space programs. The company works closely with OEMs and space agencies to ensure compliance with international standards and mission-critical performance requirements.
Van Halteren Technologies Boxtel B.V. is committed to innovation, quality, and sustainability, continuously investing in R&D and workforce development. Its multidisciplinary teams collaborate across the Van Halteren group to deliver integrated solutions that push the boundaries of technology—on land, at sea, and now, in space.

The Prague Innovation Institute (Pii) is an organization dedicated to fostering innovation in various sectors, including business, education, and city development, and is powered by the City of Prague. Established in January 2020, Pii operates as a public benefit organization focusing on supporting the development of education, the city's infrastructure, and the environment.
Key aspects of Pii's mission include:
- Support for Entrepreneurs and Startups: Pii offers crucial support to early-stage entrepreneurs and startups, helping them turn their innovative ideas into successful ventures. This includes providing guidance, tailored solutions, and a network of opportunities.

- Educational Advancement: Unique in Czechia, Pii is the only innovation center focused on advancing education. It collaborates with schools at all levels of the education system, striving to improve education for all and address individual children's needs.

- City Development Initiatives: Pii aims to improve Prague's environment through the promotion of modern technologies in energy, sustainable development, and waste management, including the use of renewable energy sources.

- Collaboration with Academia and Business: Pii works closely with academic institutions like the Czech Technical University in Prague (CTU), focusing on applied research and the promotion of new scientific knowledge. This collaboration extends to supporting platforms that aid in the creation and development of spin-off and startup companies.

- Innovation Strategy: Pii aligns its goals with the Innovation Strategy set by the Czech Republic until 2030 and other strategic initiatives like the Smart Prague Concept. It works on connecting various innovation actors, including researchers, entrepreneurs, and the public sector.

Waldfreunde gGmbH is a non-profit organization based in Dreieich, Germany, focused on reforestation and the protection of native forests. The organization unites communities, companies, and individuals in hands-on environmental efforts by planting trees and fostering a deeper connection with nature.
Mission
The mission of Waldfreunde is to bring people together to plant trees and to create more than just carbon offsetting. Their goal is to enable shared, meaningful experiences that promote environmental awareness and inspire action.
Core Purpose
Waldfreunde aims to combat climate change through regional reforestation, strengthen biodiversity, promote sustainability, and build emotional connections to nature. The organization emphasizes personal responsibility, education, and corporate engagement.
Team and Structure
The organization is led by co-CEOs Jürgen Graf (CEO & Sales) and Jennifer Graf (CEO & Marketing). They are supported by a focused team including Sandra Luschtinetz (Operations & Security), Anton Strecker (Operations & Events), Michael Köpﬂer (Project Manager) and Christine Rumpf (Finance & Budget). The team combines operational expertise with a shared commitment to environmental action.
Key Offerings
Waldfreunde offers corporate tree-planting events as teambuilding activities, community planting days, environmental education programs, and strategic partnerships for companies seeking to improve their sustainability performance. 
Now we are planning a new product, a digital platform aimed at revolutionizing reforestation. Their goal is to connect technology and nature to make reforestation more efficient, data-driven, and better controllable. Summary of the planned product:• A central interface for forest owners, municipalities, companies, and employees• AI-supported area analysis and real-time forecasts for better planting planning• Integration of various data sources (e.g., satellite data such as Sentinel, SMOS, FLEX, etc.)• Reforestation with people, drones, and robots – hybrid, scalable, future-orientedWith this, Waldfreunde aims to create a connecting system that offers transparency, overview, and effective management for reforestation projects – especially in times of climate crisis, extreme weather, and forest loss. A scalable technology product for digital, networked reforestation that combines ecological impact with modern infrastructure.
Partners and Supporters
The organization collaborates with local authorities, foundations, schools, and companies. They actively involve volunteers and foster long-term relationships to scale environmental impact.

LEON Systems is a post-proof-of-concept modular spacecraft infrastructure built from the ground up by a self-taught UK innovator using nothing but a smartphone and sheer will. Designed for deep space missions, LEON merges nuclear thermal propulsion, plasma systems, and cryogenic-integrated thermal architecture with a smart AI control stack to deliver an adaptable spacecraft backbone — capable of autonomous mission management, modular expansion, and real-time failure recovery. Unlike traditional systems, LEON isn’t a siloed vehicle — it’s a scalable space infrastructure platform built to evolve with advancing propulsion tech, AI, and mission design. From Mars freight drops to lunar satellite relays, LEON’s architecture supports multiple roles with low-cost reconfiguration and AI-managed operations. Best of all, its the ECOboost of the rocket world with a mars transit turn aroud calculated to just 4 months. thats 1 mission, from earth, to mars and back again!
About the Founder — Jay Pratt I’m Jay Pratt, an independent builder from the UK. I left school at 15. No formal training, no backing, no credentials. Told I’d never amount to anything. So I built LEON. Not to prove them wrong — but to prove the future right. With no labs or funding, I mapped, designed, documented, and simulated a full spacecraft architecture using only a mobile phone. Now I’m connecting with ESA, NFX, STFC, and accelerators — not to pitch a fantasy, but to bring a real, technical, ground-tested space system to life. 
Tech Highlights Hybrid Propulsion Stack:
Nuclear Thermal + Plasma + Cryo-fed logic Modular Architecture: Built for quick upgrades, part replacement, and mission pivots AI Stack: Handles autonomous mission control, fault recovery, and optimization Thermal Control: Smart cryogenic flow systems integrated with propulsion logic Self-diagnostic & Sim-tested: Documented recovery logic for major system failures
